materialization_decisions.statement: Materialize the approved BOUNDED_DUAL_REALIZATION_OPI_SOURCE_ARTIFACT as a candidate for internal position selector 1.
Preserve VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE as parallel complete source realizations with no preferred realization.
Keep the materialized object a CANDIDATE source artifact, not an authored or validated OPI item.

governance_decisions.statement: Artifact materialization is not OPI authoring or OPI validation.
No subject/person, tense/aspect, copula or natural-language translation semantics are introduced or inferred.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
VALI FROZEN and PARAZAMI WATCH lexical authorities remain unchanged.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only this position-1 source-artifact materialization while this gate remains active.
